q: Does CBAM apply to petrochemical exports from Map Ta Phut?
title: Map Ta Phut exports and CBAM
short: Mostly not today. CBAM covers cement, iron and steel, aluminium, fertilisers, hydrogen and electricity. Polymers and organic chemicals are outside, though hydrogen, ammonia based fertilisers and steel or aluminium parts shipped from the estate are inside. The Commission is reviewing an extension, so check the scope every year.
audience: Petrochemical, fertiliser and metal exporters on the Eastern Seaboard

ul: Steel and aluminium goods, including tanks and structures.

p: EU buyers outside CBAM still ask for product footprints for their own Scope 3, so a figure per grade is worth keeping.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and material invoices into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual figures an EU importer asks for. Senseible does not verify emissions or file CBAM declarations.
